# Synthetic robots.txt for the fetcher's tests. The stdlib applies the first matching rule, so it
# allows /archive/2026/x under "Allow: /"; RFC 9309 applies the longest, which disallows it. And
# only RFC 9309 knows the wildcard in the last rule.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /archive/2026/
Disallow: /*.pdf$
